name: ETH Zurich
header:
ETH Zurich
Switzerland · MSc Mathematics / Applied Mathematics; exceptional Direct Doctorate integrating MSc and doctorate
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• 30 November deadline is explicitly 11:59 AM CET; do not assume midnight.
• Direct Doctorate requires advance professor funding commitment.
• ESOP is separate and requires a 500-word independently authored thesis preproposal.
• Referee invitations are generated only after submission.
• ETH does not waive its CHF150 application fee.
• Course-topic and full course-content forms are substantial separate requirements.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can qualify for MSc consideration if its preparation matches ETH’s subject
profile and grades are excellent; the degree must be completed by the start of lectures. The 90-ECTS MSc
normally takes three semesters. Exceptional bachelor graduates can apply to the integrated Direct Doctorate
only after securing a supervisor and funding commitment; ordinary doctoral entry normally follows a master’s.
Do not infer eligibility or Swiss immigration rights from US F-1 status. [b] [c] [e]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Review ETH mathematics subject prerequisites, assemble official records from all institutions and the detailed
course-content form, select MSc/ESOP/Direct Doctorate in eApply, and obtain two referees’ consent and
institutional emails. For Direct Doctorate, find an ETH professor and obtain a written commitment to fund MSc
scholarship plus doctoral salary before submitting. For ESOP, prepare the independent thesis preproposal. [b]
[c] [e] [g] [h]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Regular MSc does not require a secured supervisor; discuss project interests in the motivation letter. Direct
Doctorate requires the applicant to find an ETH supervisor and obtain written funding/supervision commitment
before application. Pink and Wüstholz are currently listed as emeriti; David Loeffler is listed as a FernUni
lecturer, so they are not interchangeable with active ETH chairs for a new funded doctorate. [b] [c] [o] [p]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
eApply permits draft editing; after submission most application changes are blocked. Referee details remain
editable until a letter arrives. Payment and submission generate email confirmation. University records use a 5
MB per-document limit. Use the mathematics-specific course form, and inspect the final summary carefully
before submitting. [e] [f] [g] [k]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Autumn-2027 dates and ESOP amount are explicit current-cycle evidence. Other mechanics are standing
official guidance. The older direct-doctorate directive’s CHF12,000/semester footnote is not a verified 2027
amount and has not been substituted for the explicit new ESOP rate. [a] [h] [r]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
International bachelor’s applicants must apply 1-30 November 2026; final deadline 30 November 2026, 11:59
AM CET, for autumn 2027. The official page explicitly says AM. April 2027 is restricted to Swiss bachelor’s
applicants and is not a fallback for UChicago graduates. Semester starts 20 September 2027; no spring MSc
entry. [a]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
ESOP and Direct Doctorate must accompany the November application by 30 November 2026, 11:59 AM CET.
ESOP decisions are expected by end March 2027; February phone/video interviews may occur. [a] [h]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
General eApply instructions allow letters until two weeks after the application deadline. For the 30 November
2026 deadline this computes to 14 December 2026; the reference page does not specify a clock time/timezone
for that grace deadline, so confirm the invitation’s exact cutoff. This exception applies to referee uploads, not
applicant documents. [a] [f] [g]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
If an English certificate is required, it must be valid and received by the application deadline;
missing/insufficient evidence leads to formal rejection and cannot be remedied later. Mathematics does not list
GRE as a programme requirement. [b] [d] [n]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Complete applicant documents must be submitted by 30 November 2026 11:59 AM CET; no late/incomplete
application processing. Referees have the separately published two-week extension. Final degree evidence is
supplied for enrollment, and degree completion must precede lectures. [a] [e] [f]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Acceptance and enrollment-document deadlines are stated in the individual admission letter and eApply.
Confirm or decline the place there; no fixed public 2027 universal acceptance date was established. [m]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
The mathematics MSc is English-taught and requires C1 English unless exempt. Recognized certificate validity
is generally two years for TOEFL/IELTS/C1 Advanced, five for C2 Proficiency or C1 Advanced Grade A. The exact
score table was not exposed by the public page extraction; use the live recognized-certificates list if the
exemption does not apply. [b] [d]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A bachelor’s programme taught entirely in English qualifies for exemption; no separate language-of-instruction
confirmation is required for bachelor’s degrees from the United States. Thus a completed English-taught
UChicago BA meets the published exemption basis. Applicants still finishing the degree should ensure their
eApply evidence establishes that basis rather than assume a later test can cure a missing exemption. [d]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not listed in the mathematics-specific application checklist. ETH’s general GRE page applies only where the
particular programme stipulates it; do not import the GRE requirement of ETH computer science or other
programmes into mathematics. Whether optional scores can be entered for mathematics was not established.
[b] [n]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
No Mathematics Subject GRE requirement is listed. ETH’s general guidance says a Subject Test cannot replace
a required General Test elsewhere; that does not create a mathematics MSc test requirement. Optional-score
acceptance was not established. [b] [n]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Official up-to-date transcripts from every university, including exchange, unfinished and double-degree
studies; student-portal printouts/screenshots are not accepted. Completed degrees require degree evidence;
ongoing studies require enrollment/status confirmation with intended degree and duration. Include
upper-secondary graduation certificate and passport copy; signed consent form. University-document limit 5
MB. Non-English/German/French/Italian records need the original plus an authorized English translation. [e] [f] [l]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required: complete the mathematics covered-topics list once for the application, including planned courses
and all prior/exchange institutions. Identify corresponding course titles and textbook or lecturer for checked
topics. Gaps in the broad topic checklist are normal, not automatic rejection. [b] [k]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Required: course-content abstracts for the complete programme, one document per university/programme,
including planned courses. The template requests course descriptions/textbooks, dates, credits, contact hours,
grading scale and course-catalogue URL. Use the provided form; Adobe Acrobat Reader is recommended for its
dynamic page features. [b] [f] [k]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two recommendation letters; academic referees or academically trained referees preferred for MSc. Use valid
official institutional emails; private addresses such as Gmail are not accepted. [b] [g]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
The same two MSc references serve ESOP; no extra letters required. ESOP guidance is stricter: both referees
should be professors by title and position, know the applicant, and provide signed letters on university-logo
letterhead. General requests also ask for a short academic-performance assessment. [g] [j]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering referee details does not itself trigger the request: the system contacts them after the application is
submitted. An automatic reminder follows after ten days without an upload. [g]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: automatic invitations are sent only after submission. Submit early enough for referees to respond; do not
wait for an invitation while the application remains a draft. [f] [g]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
After submission, eApply shows recommendation status and changes it to received when uploaded. The
applicant cannot view the confidential letter. [f] [g]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
After submission, incorrect referee details can be edited and a referee replaced, but additional referees cannot
be added. Once a letter is received, editing is blocked. The same letters serve MSc and ESOP; reuse across
separate degree applications or cycles was not established. [f] [g]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required English chronological tabular CV from upper-secondary graduation to present, including education,
work and any gaps such as travel/time off. Upload; no separate public page/word limit found. Include a
reachable phone number for possible ESOP interview. [f] [h]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required motivation letter, approximately one A4 page in English. Faithful paraphrase: explain why this ETH
mathematics programme, your preparation and intentions, and proposed courses, specializations and project
supervisors. Direct Doctorate applicants also explain their suitability for the planned research. Upload;
font/margin rules not published. [b] [f]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate compulsory personal/background statement is listed. Personal context may inform the motivation
letter; permission for an additional unsolicited essay was not established. [b] [f]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Include intended specialization and project supervisors within the one-page motivation letter. Direct Doctorate
requires suitability for the planned research and the supervisor’s funding confirmation; no separate universal
research-interest essay specified. [b] [c]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
ESOP requires a separate independently authored MSc thesis preproposal, maximum 500 words excluding
references. Faithful paraphrase: proposed topic/title, context and significance, questions/goals, methods, prior
work, feasible four-to-six-month timetable/milestones, and scholarly references. Structured
paragraphs/subheadings are advised; upload through ESOP tab. Regular MSc has no separate proposal listed.
[h] [i]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No mathematics writing sample or thesis upload is requested in the public checklist. No portfolio can be
submitted for mathematics under the general rule reserving portfolios to architecture programmes. Do not
infer that unsolicited papers may be uploaded. [b] [f]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate publications-list requirement is listed. Relevant achievements may fit the CV; an
upload-versus-link rule for research papers is not established. [b] [f]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Required mathematics topics and course-content forms; see course-list and course-description fields. Include
future courses as well as completed work. [b] [k]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
ESOP adds the independent 500-word thesis preproposal (references excluded), while reusing two references;
no separate additional scholarship essay is listed. Bachelor performance should be top 10% by
self-assessment. Already holding a master’s or being enrolled in an ETH master’s disqualifies ESOP. [h] [i] [j]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Required signed consent form; Direct Doctorate requires written supervisor confirmation explicitly undertaking
MSc scholarship and subsequent doctoral salary. eApply also requests education history, language information
and relevant scholarship choices. No additional portal-only short-answer limits verified. [b] [f]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
ESOP explicitly increases from autumn 2027 to CHF13,500 per semester plus a tuition-fee waiver. Two
semesters equal CHF27,000 by arithmetic; the award is denominated per semester, not a salary. Regular MSc
admission has no automatic stipend. Direct Doctorate requires professor-funded MSc scholarship and later
salary; a 2027 mathematics salary amount was not established. [b] [h]
Years of support [Standing rule]
ESOP covers the regular three- or four-semester programme duration; mathematics MSc is normally three

semesters/90 ECTS. Direct Doctorate includes MSc and doctoral phases under the supervisor’s commitment,
but precise doctoral contract duration must be obtained from the offer. [c] [h]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The November ESOP route expressly includes international bachelor’s applicants and does not list a citizenship
restriction. International students can apply to Direct Doctorate subject to admission, supervisor funding and
Swiss immigration requirements. No assumption about nationality follows from F-1. [a] [b] [h]
Conditions and duties [2027 confirmed]
ESOP is selective (approximately 60 awards for 2027-28) and expects top-10% bachelor performance; no prior
master’s and no current ETH master enrollment. The proposal must be independently developed with proper
citations. Direct Doctorate requires exceptional academic performance and a funded supervisor commitment.
[b] [h] [i]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Select ESOP in the MSc eApply application and upload the preproposal by the first-window deadline. Direct
Doctorate is likewise linked to the MSc application, requiring the supervisor letter. Neither arises automatically
from ordinary MSc admission. [a] [b] [h]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
ETH lists social/need-based scholarships and external routes in its financial-aid overview, generally for a first
education. Award-specific eligibility and whether support is available before the first semester must be
checked; no alternative guaranteed incoming-MSc amount was established. [q]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CHF150 per programme for an international bachelor’s application, non-refundable, payable at submission by
Visa/Mastercard or PostFinance card. At most two different degree programmes per semester. [e]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
The international-bachelor application page explicitly says the fee cannot be waived. [e]

The headline complete-application deadline has an explicit exception for referee uploads two weeks later.
General GRE text must be read subject to programme-specific requirements. Some public dynamic sections
omit country labels and English score tables in extraction; no numeric US GPA minimum or alternative test
score was guessed. [a] [b] [d] [f] [n] [s]
Checks still needed [Standing rule]

grace-period time in the invitation and acceptance deadline in the offer. Inspect live English table only if the
US-degree exemption fails. Confirm mathematics Direct Doctorate scholarship/salary and contract duration in
writing. Research fit below prioritizes enumerative/arithmetic geometry and number theory; prospective 2027
capacity is unconfirmed. [b] [c] [d] [f] [h] [m]

text:
ETH Zurich
Switzerland · MSc Mathematics / Applied Mathematics; exceptional Direct Doctorate integrating MSc and doctorate
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• 30 November deadline is explicitly 11:59 AM CET; do not assume midnight.
• Direct Doctorate requires advance professor funding commitment.
• ESOP is separate and requires a 500-word independently authored thesis preproposal.
• Referee invitations are generated only after submission.
• ETH does not waive its CHF150 application fee.
• Course-topic and full course-content forms are substantial separate requirements.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can qualify for MSc consideration if its preparation matches ETH’s subject
profile and grades are excellent; the degree must be completed by the start of lectures. The 90-ECTS MSc
normally takes three semesters. Exceptional bachelor graduates can apply to the integrated Direct Doctorate
only after securing a supervisor and funding commitment; ordinary doctoral entry normally follows a master’s.
Do not infer eligibility or Swiss immigration rights from US F-1 status. [b] [c] [e]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Review ETH mathematics subject prerequisites, assemble official records from all institutions and the detailed
course-content form, select MSc/ESOP/Direct Doctorate in eApply, and obtain two referees’ consent and
institutional emails. For Direct Doctorate, find an ETH professor and obtain a written commitment to fund MSc
scholarship plus doctoral salary before submitting. For ESOP, prepare the independent thesis preproposal. [b]
[c] [e] [g] [h]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Regular MSc does not require a secured supervisor; discuss project interests in the motivation letter. Direct
Doctorate requires the applicant to find an ETH supervisor and obtain written funding/supervision commitment
before application. Pink and Wüstholz are currently listed as emeriti; David Loeffler is listed as a FernUni
lecturer, so they are not interchangeable with active ETH chairs for a new funded doctorate. [b] [c] [o] [p]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
eApply permits draft editing; after submission most application changes are blocked. Referee details remain
editable until a letter arrives. Payment and submission generate email confirmation. University records use a 5
MB per-document limit. Use the mathematics-specific course form, and inspect the final summary carefully
before submitting. [e] [f] [g] [k]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Autumn-2027 dates and ESOP amount are explicit current-cycle evidence. Other mechanics are standing
official guidance. The older direct-doctorate directive’s CHF12,000/semester footnote is not a verified 2027
amount and has not been substituted for the explicit new ESOP rate. [a] [h] [r]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
International bachelor’s applicants must apply 1-30 November 2026; final deadline 30 November 2026, 11:59
AM CET, for autumn 2027. The official page explicitly says AM. April 2027 is restricted to Swiss bachelor’s
applicants and is not a fallback for UChicago graduates. Semester starts 20 September 2027; no spring MSc
entry. [a]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
ESOP and Direct Doctorate must accompany the November application by 30 November 2026, 11:59 AM CET.
ESOP decisions are expected by end March 2027; February phone/video interviews may occur. [a] [h]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
General eApply instructions allow letters until two weeks after the application deadline. For the 30 November
2026 deadline this computes to 14 December 2026; the reference page does not specify a clock time/timezone
for that grace deadline, so confirm the invitation’s exact cutoff. This exception applies to referee uploads, not
applicant documents. [a] [f] [g]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
If an English certificate is required, it must be valid and received by the application deadline;
missing/insufficient evidence leads to formal rejection and cannot be remedied later. Mathematics does not list
GRE as a programme requirement. [b] [d] [n]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Complete applicant documents must be submitted by 30 November 2026 11:59 AM CET; no late/incomplete
application processing. Referees have the separately published two-week extension. Final degree evidence is
supplied for enrollment, and degree completion must precede lectures. [a] [e] [f]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Acceptance and enrollment-document deadlines are stated in the individual admission letter and eApply.
Confirm or decline the place there; no fixed public 2027 universal acceptance date was established. [m]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
The mathematics MSc is English-taught and requires C1 English unless exempt. Recognized certificate validity
is generally two years for TOEFL/IELTS/C1 Advanced, five for C2 Proficiency or C1 Advanced Grade A. The exact
score table was not exposed by the public page extraction; use the live recognized-certificates list if the
exemption does not apply. [b] [d]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A bachelor’s programme taught entirely in English qualifies for exemption; no separate language-of-instruction
confirmation is required for bachelor’s degrees from the United States. Thus a completed English-taught
UChicago BA meets the published exemption basis. Applicants still finishing the degree should ensure their
eApply evidence establishes that basis rather than assume a later test can cure a missing exemption. [d]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not listed in the mathematics-specific application checklist. ETH’s general GRE page applies only where the
particular programme stipulates it; do not import the GRE requirement of ETH computer science or other
programmes into mathematics. Whether optional scores can be entered for mathematics was not established.
[b] [n]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
No Mathematics Subject GRE requirement is listed. ETH’s general guidance says a Subject Test cannot replace
a required General Test elsewhere; that does not create a mathematics MSc test requirement. Optional-score
acceptance was not established. [b] [n]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Official up-to-date transcripts from every university, including exchange, unfinished and double-degree
studies; student-portal printouts/screenshots are not accepted. Completed degrees require degree evidence;
ongoing studies require enrollment/status confirmation with intended degree and duration. Include
upper-secondary graduation certificate and passport copy; signed consent form. University-document limit 5
MB. Non-English/German/French/Italian records need the original plus an authorized English translation. [e] [f] [l]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required: complete the mathematics covered-topics list once for the application, including planned courses
and all prior/exchange institutions. Identify corresponding course titles and textbook or lecturer for checked
topics. Gaps in the broad topic checklist are normal, not automatic rejection. [b] [k]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Required: course-content abstracts for the complete programme, one document per university/programme,
including planned courses. The template requests course descriptions/textbooks, dates, credits, contact hours,
grading scale and course-catalogue URL. Use the provided form; Adobe Acrobat Reader is recommended for its
dynamic page features. [b] [f] [k]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two recommendation letters; academic referees or academically trained referees preferred for MSc. Use valid
official institutional emails; private addresses such as Gmail are not accepted. [b] [g]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
The same two MSc references serve ESOP; no extra letters required. ESOP guidance is stricter: both referees
should be professors by title and position, know the applicant, and provide signed letters on university-logo
letterhead. General requests also ask for a short academic-performance assessment. [g] [j]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering referee details does not itself trigger the request: the system contacts them after the application is
submitted. An automatic reminder follows after ten days without an upload. [g]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: automatic invitations are sent only after submission. Submit early enough for referees to respond; do not
wait for an invitation while the application remains a draft. [f] [g]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
After submission, eApply shows recommendation status and changes it to received when uploaded. The
applicant cannot view the confidential letter. [f] [g]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
After submission, incorrect referee details can be edited and a referee replaced, but additional referees cannot
be added. Once a letter is received, editing is blocked. The same letters serve MSc and ESOP; reuse across
separate degree applications or cycles was not established. [f] [g]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required English chronological tabular CV from upper-secondary graduation to present, including education,
work and any gaps such as travel/time off. Upload; no separate public page/word limit found. Include a
reachable phone number for possible ESOP interview. [f] [h]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required motivation letter, approximately one A4 page in English. Faithful paraphrase: explain why this ETH
mathematics programme, your preparation and intentions, and proposed courses, specializations and project
supervisors. Direct Doctorate applicants also explain their suitability for the planned research. Upload;
font/margin rules not published. [b] [f]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate compulsory personal/background statement is listed. Personal context may inform the motivation
letter; permission for an additional unsolicited essay was not established. [b] [f]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Include intended specialization and project supervisors within the one-page motivation letter. Direct Doctorate
requires suitability for the planned research and the supervisor’s funding confirmation; no separate universal
research-interest essay specified. [b] [c]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
ESOP requires a separate independently authored MSc thesis preproposal, maximum 500 words excluding
references. Faithful paraphrase: proposed topic/title, context and significance, questions/goals, methods, prior
work, feasible four-to-six-month timetable/milestones, and scholarly references. Structured
paragraphs/subheadings are advised; upload through ESOP tab. Regular MSc has no separate proposal listed.
[h] [i]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No mathematics writing sample or thesis upload is requested in the public checklist. No portfolio can be
submitted for mathematics under the general rule reserving portfolios to architecture programmes. Do not
infer that unsolicited papers may be uploaded. [b] [f]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate publications-list requirement is listed. Relevant achievements may fit the CV; an
upload-versus-link rule for research papers is not established. [b] [f]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Required mathematics topics and course-content forms; see course-list and course-description fields. Include
future courses as well as completed work. [b] [k]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
ESOP adds the independent 500-word thesis preproposal (references excluded), while reusing two references;
no separate additional scholarship essay is listed. Bachelor performance should be top 10% by
self-assessment. Already holding a master’s or being enrolled in an ETH master’s disqualifies ESOP. [h] [i] [j]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Required signed consent form; Direct Doctorate requires written supervisor confirmation explicitly undertaking
MSc scholarship and subsequent doctoral salary. eApply also requests education history, language information
and relevant scholarship choices. No additional portal-only short-answer limits verified. [b] [f]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
ESOP explicitly increases from autumn 2027 to CHF13,500 per semester plus a tuition-fee waiver. Two
semesters equal CHF27,000 by arithmetic; the award is denominated per semester, not a salary. Regular MSc
admission has no automatic stipend. Direct Doctorate requires professor-funded MSc scholarship and later
salary; a 2027 mathematics salary amount was not established. [b] [h]
Years of support [Standing rule]
ESOP covers the regular three- or four-semester programme duration; mathematics MSc is normally three

semesters/90 ECTS. Direct Doctorate includes MSc and doctoral phases under the supervisor’s commitment,
but precise doctoral contract duration must be obtained from the offer. [c] [h]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The November ESOP route expressly includes international bachelor’s applicants and does not list a citizenship
restriction. International students can apply to Direct Doctorate subject to admission, supervisor funding and
Swiss immigration requirements. No assumption about nationality follows from F-1. [a] [b] [h]
Conditions and duties [2027 confirmed]
ESOP is selective (approximately 60 awards for 2027-28) and expects top-10% bachelor performance; no prior
master’s and no current ETH master enrollment. The proposal must be independently developed with proper
citations. Direct Doctorate requires exceptional academic performance and a funded supervisor commitment.
[b] [h] [i]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Select ESOP in the MSc eApply application and upload the preproposal by the first-window deadline. Direct
Doctorate is likewise linked to the MSc application, requiring the supervisor letter. Neither arises automatically
from ordinary MSc admission. [a] [b] [h]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
ETH lists social/need-based scholarships and external routes in its financial-aid overview, generally for a first
education. Award-specific eligibility and whether support is available before the first semester must be
checked; no alternative guaranteed incoming-MSc amount was established. [q]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CHF150 per programme for an international bachelor’s application, non-refundable, payable at submission by
Visa/Mastercard or PostFinance card. At most two different degree programmes per semester. [e]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
The international-bachelor application page explicitly says the fee cannot be waived. [e]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Standing rule]
The headline complete-application deadline has an explicit exception for referee uploads two weeks later.
General GRE text must be read subject to programme-specific requirements. Some public dynamic sections
omit country labels and English score tables in extraction; no numeric US GPA minimum or alternative test
score was guessed. [a] [b] [d] [f] [n] [s]
Checks still needed [Standing rule]
Confirm any direct-doctorate supervisor immediately given the November cutoff. Verify exact referee
grace-period time in the invitation and acceptance deadline in the offer. Inspect live English table only if the
US-degree exemption fails. Confirm mathematics Direct Doctorate scholarship/salary and contract duration in
writing. Research fit below prioritizes enumerative/arithmetic geometry and number theory; prospective 2027
capacity is unconfirmed. [b] [c] [d] [f] [h] [m]
Potential advisers and recent research
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Rahul Pandharipande
Enumerative geometry, Gromov-Witten/Donaldson-Thomas theory, moduli of curves and K3 surfaces. [fp] [o] [p]
Current ETH professor; availability unknown.

Modular and automorphic forms, periods and cycle integrals, theta lifts, real quadratic arithmetic; recent work
includes Mellin transforms for weakly holomorphic forms and converse theorems. [fi] [o] [p] [euqb4] [euqb5]

official ETH list.
